authored_by: main-agent reading of the public source text
notes: Expectations were written from the A2AJ source text before any Jev call for these items. They are independent of the repository's Codex-authored gold files and of the retired runner. 'present_court' means a judge of the deciding court, including a judge writing a separate concurring or dissenting opinion.

items.anchor: The parties agreed the appropriate amount of costs for the successful party
items.rationale: The Court of Appeal is quoting the application judge's costs endorsement, and then reverses that costs award to the agreed $42,500.

items.anchor: while courts should pay heed to these ranges, they are guidelines rather than hard and fast rules
items.rationale: Fenlon J.A. reports words of Labelle J. in R. v. Nasogaluak, 2010 SCC 6, reached through defence counsel's reliance, and then relies on the same proposition herself.

items.anchor: I have had the privilege of reading the draft reasons of my colleague Madam Justice Fenlon
items.rationale: Smith J.A. agrees with the disposition but holds that the judge erred in applying the parity principle.

items.anchor: the proper approach to the definition of the rights and freedoms guaranteed by the Charter was a purposive one
items.rationale: The joint reasons quote Big M Drug Mart and call it the definitive account of the approach.

items.anchor: Justice Cormier committed an error of mixed fact and law when she misapprehended the law
items.rationale: The passage is set out from Ms. Piper's factum. The court does not adopt the alleged error; it notes Sattva does not govern whether a contract exists.

items.anchor: While the surrounding circumstances will be considered in interpreting the terms of a contract
items.rationale: The court quotes Sattva Capital Corp. v. Creston Moly Corp. and applies its interpretive principles.

items.anchor: I note that Sattva does not apply to determine whether a contract exists
items.rationale: This sentence is the deciding court's own reasoning about the scope of Sattva.

items.anchor: Although I am not in full agreement with Mr. Justice Létourneau
items.rationale: The separate reasons agree the appeal should be dismissed but not with the colleague's reasons.
